operations.name: accounts
operations.summary: List public accounts and their currencies and classifications.

output.description: Public account/category/transaction records; identifiers, currencies and integer amounts come from the addressed budget.

items.description: Public accounts record. Additional compatible projection fields may be present.

type.description: Financial account type, independent of budget scope: depository = cash/checking/savings; credit = credit card/line of credit; investment = brokerage; retirement = retirement; property = property; loan = loan; deposit = CD/term deposit; other_asset/other_liability = other tracking asset/debt; other = generic unclassified account, not a credit-card classification. Credit, loan and other_liability are liabilities with a positive amount owed.

balance.description: Current integer-minor-unit balance; null when unknown. Assets carry signed value; liabilities carry a positive amount owed. Classifying an imported account does not verify its balance estimate or fetch a fresh bank balance.

source.description: Record origin, such as ynab, plaid or manual; this is separate from the financial type and onBudget classification.

stale.description: Whether the account snapshot is stale.

onBudget.description: True includes the account in monthly envelope funding/activity; false keeps it for tracking outside envelopes. Only depository and credit may be on budget. New cash/credit accounts default on budget; other types default off budget. An on-budget credit card still represents debt. Existing accounts retain their budget scope when changed to cash/credit unless onBudget is supplied explicitly. Unclassified imports may begin as other, off budget; inspect their saved values before editing.

operations.name: bank.investments
operations.summary: Read current investment positions, value, reported basis, unrealized dollar/percentage return and available investment activity.

input.description: POST /budgets/{budget}/api/banks/{provider}/investments. CLI: whab BUDGET bank investments PROVIDER --item ID [--bank-account PROVIDER_ACCOUNT_ID] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD]; whab-cli PROFILE supports the same command.

itemId.description: Existing connection ID from bank connections; required.

bankAccountId.description: Provider account ID from preview or this report; null/omitted selects all investment accounts. Not a WHAB destination ID.

startDate.description: Inclusive activity start; null/omitted defaults to two years before endDate, using Feb 28 for a missing leap day.

endDate.description: Inclusive activity end; null/omitted defaults to today. Holdings always show current provider snapshot.

output.description: Read-only positions and activity with shared core calculations. Unknown dates/basis/returns remain null; currencies are totaled separately.

items.description: Provider investment account; IDs are not WHAB ledger account IDs.

mask.description: Masked account suffix, empty when absent.

balance.description: Provider current balance; null when absent. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

positions.description: Current holdings, not historical holdings at --until.

items.description: Current position, independently of the selected activity window.

accountId.description: Provider account ID within this report.

ticker.description: Ticker, or null when not supplied.

quantity.description: Current quantity; negative denotes a short position. Finite decimal string, not a binary float.

price.description: Provider institution unit price; null when absent. Finite decimal string, not a binary float.

value.description: Current institution position value. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

costBasis.description: Provider total position cost basis; null when absent. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

currency.description: Position and owning account ISO currency.

priceAsOf.description: Provider price date; null when absent.

unrealizedGain.description: Value minus positive reported cost basis for a nonshort position; null otherwise. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

unrealizedReturnPercent.description: 100 * unrealizedGain / costBasis, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places; null when unavailable. Finite decimal string, not a binary float.

unrealizedUnavailableReason.description: Why unrealized gain and percentage are unavailable.

firstRecordedAddition.description: Earliest uncancelled buy or explicit inbound transfer with positive quantity in this window. Not the original acquisition/tax-lot date; null when absent.

realizedGain.description: Unavailable: complete acquisition/disposal lot history is not supplied.

realizedReturnPercent.description: Unavailable: no realized lot return is inferred.

activity.description: Available provider investment history in the requested inclusive window.

items.description: One provider investment event; amounts retain provider sign, positive for cash outflow and negative for inflow.

securityId.description: Security ID, or null for unassociated cash activity.

date.description: Event date within the inclusive requested window.

subtype.description: Provider investment event subtype, or null.

amount.description: Signed event cash amount: positive outflow, negative inflow. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

fees.description: Provider fees, or null. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

quantity.description: Event quantity; zero when absent. Finite decimal string, not a binary float.

price.description: Event unit price, or null. Finite decimal string, not a binary float.

currency.description: Event and owning account ISO currency.

cancelTransactionId.description: ID cancelled by this event, or null.

asOf.description: Offset ISO timestamp when WHAB read the cached snapshot.

providerUpdatedAt.description: Provider last successful Investments update timestamp, or null.

startDate.description: Inclusive activity start; does not change transaction import cutoff.

endDate.description: Inclusive activity end; does not change holdings valuation date.

totals.description: Separate totals per currency; no FX conversion.

items.description: One currency only. Covered totals include only positions with supported positive cost basis; consult coveredPositions before treating zero as measured.

value.description: Value of all positions. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

coveredValue.description: Value of positions with computable unrealized return. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

costBasis.description: Cost basis of covered positions only. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

unrealizedGain.description: Gain of covered positions only; zero with no covered positions. Integer currency minor units; no conversion.

coveredPositions.description: Number of positions included in covered totals.

unrealizedReturnPercent.description: Covered gain / covered cost basis * 100; null without coverage. Finite decimal string, not a binary float.

realizedReturnsAvailable.description: False: realized returns require complete lot history.

output.additionDateMeaning: Earliest recorded buy or inbound transfer within the requested history; not an original tax-lot acquisition date.
output.returnMeaning: Unrealized change versus reported position cost basis; excludes distributions and realized returns. Realized returns require complete lot history.

operations.side_effects: Reads already-active Investments provider endpoints. No ledger import, saved cursor, destination, history cutoff or schedule is changed. Does not enable a product, request consent, reconnect or force a fresh institution fetch. Existing provider product billing applies.
operations.permissions: Authenticated local HTTPS host with existing budget/environment/provider access guards and a runtime lease; unavailable through remote ledger operations. Credentials stay in the host/provider worker.
operations.scope: One personal budget, environment, provider and existing Item. Optional filter is a provider investment account ID. Currency totals remain separate. Current holdings and selected activity history have different time semantics.
errors: Unavailable provider/configuration, unsupported investment adapter, foreign Item/account or malformed dates fail explicitly.
Investments must already be active and consented on the Item; no product is silently enabled. Provider not-ready/reconnect conditions require their documented action.
Invalid provider DTO, unsupported currency, excessive history or inconsistent snapshot/window fails without partial results.
operations.retry: Read-only and safe to retry after addressing the fixed error. Do not create a duplicate connection or infer successful product activation. Loading again reads Plaid cached data and does not force a bank refresh.
operations.availability: WHAB 2.60+, CLI 2.3+, and Plaid 1.7+; provider must declare BankAdapter.supports_investments. Plaid Investments must be separately enabled/consented. Investment history availability varies by institution; default window is two years.

operations.name: history
operations.summary: Read permanent financial history.

target.description: Entry or batch ID to inspect.

snapshot.description: Return a historical financial snapshot instead of entry metadata.

output.description: History metadata, changes/preview fingerprint, historical snapshot or action result.

operations.side_effects: Read only; excludes credentials, provider cursors and attachment bytes.
errors: Unavailable history storage, invalid/stale preview, missing/ambiguous target or conflicting later edits fail explicitly.
operations.retry: Keep the exact request ID, original revision and parameters for an uncertain write; receipts are bounded and restart requires reconciliation.
operations.availability: WHAB 2.62+ and a BudgetHistoryStorage adapter. History starts with a baseline; earlier edits are not reconstructed.
